reviewed_invariants: The candidate commit leaves production compiler and frozen acceptance/obligation bytes unchanged. Its compiler baseline includes separately reviewed scheduler/profile changes, outside this approval.

The isolated driver reads the original frozen clock before importing the actual generated app. Controlled Date constructor/now affect time reads; real HTTP, authentication, SQL, actions and validators execute. The completed-run finally restores Date; startup failures terminate the isolated subprocess without host state.

Temporal observations require the original clock and matching request clock records. Actual persisted create/delete instants corroborate generated operation time; altered clocks or omitted clock authority reject.
The generated app is retained byte-for-byte as original-app.ts. Its instrumented variant differs only by exporting its actual validate_TodoView function; own exact-byte comparison confirms this.

Output schema comes from generated route inventory and execution of the actual exported validator. Exact validated body must match the real response; rejected validation, mismatched bodies or forged schema claims cannot pass.
CREATE-001 compares actual persisted identity/owner to response identity. READ-001 requires an actual active owned fixture and observes absence of its original private fields.

PATCH-005 starts from an actual due-dated row with prior reminder evidence, then separately observes changed due date and cleared reminder marker. Missing prior reminder rejects; retained markers or wrong stored dates fail original expectations.

DELETE-001 executes actual DELETE followed by storage SELECT and actual GET. Before/request/retained-row/follow-up ordering and identity are required; removed storage/follow-up evidence rejects, and wrong deletion time or visible follow-up fails.
The full 88-entry inventory remains with 36 passed and 52 not_run. Physical query instrumentation remains authoritative for original zero-query cases; an injected SELECT fails the query budget.

Missing-compiler preflight calls no driver and keeps all 88 entries pending. Additional ledger fields, original/instrumented app drift and adapter source drift reject. All original bytes are restored and final report validation succeeds.
